final: WITH j AS (SELECT j.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member m ON CAST(i.link_to_member AS TEXT) = CAST(m.member_id AS TEXT) JOIN major j ON CAST(m.link_to_major AS TEXT) = CAST(j.major_id AS TEXT)), g AS (SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS s FROM j WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY college), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.college, g.s, CAST(g.s AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL
